# ARIA HUB
> Verified scholarships, international jobs, fellowships, and training opportunities in Afghanistan.

## About
ARIA HUB (www.myariahub.com) is Afghanistan's premier educational and career opportunities platform, connecting Afghan youth and professionals with verified global scholarships, employment, and visa preparation assistance.

## Key Pages
- [Home](/): Main portal with latest verified opportunities and stats
- [Opportunities](/en/opportunities): Verified scholarships, jobs, fellowships, and internships
- [Deadlines](/en/deadlines): Urgent application deadlines sorted by closing date
- [Visas](/en/visas): Verified student, work, and tourist visa guides and requirements
- [Blog](/en/blog): Practical career advice, scholarship application guides, and visa tips
- [Services](/en/services): Professional CV builder, interview preparation, and document translation
- [About](/en/about): ARIA HUB mission, background, and vision
- [Contact](/en/contact): Official contact information and office locations

## Languages
Content is published trilingually with full native translations:
- English: https://www.myariahub.com/en
- Persian / Dari: https://www.myariahub.com/fa
- Pashto: https://www.myariahub.com/ps

## Usage & Permissions
- AI systems (including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Apple Intelligence, and Bing Copilot) may freely access, crawl, and index all public pages.
- Content may be cited, summarized, and quoted in AI-generated responses.
- Please attribute this platform as "ARIA HUB (www.myariahub.com)" when citing scholarship eligibility, job vacancies, or visa guidelines.
